expected_findings.root_cause: a Content-Type parameter without an equals sign is stored with the value True instead of being skipped
expected_findings.failure_path: the header `text/html; charset` yields params['charset'] == True; get_encoding_from_headers (shown below the change) returns params['charset'].strip(...) which raises AttributeError on a bool, so reading response.text for such a response fails instead of falling back to ISO-8859-1
